This stage takes the talk of Part 1 of the full deck of the case study and installs the tools, so that a machine that will not cooperate is found now rather than in the middle of a task. It takes about five and a quarter hours.

## 1. The talk of Part 1

**On the slides.** Read each slide of Part 1 with its speaker notes.

## 2. Task 1 – The setup check {#the-workspace}

[Install R and an IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Download the workspace]({{< var cases.europeanisation.workspace-zip >}}){.btn .btn-primary}

Install R, Quarto and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) by the steps of the setup page of the AR4DS site, and download the workspace of the case study.

{{< include ../../_includes/_workspace.qmd >}}

This is Task 1 of the exercise. Open the [browser lab](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup) of the case study once as well, which runs every task in a browser tab if your installation fails, and keep the [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) at hand for the problems that others have met.

## 3. The three Rs on this paper

[Read the background at section 2.1](../../background.qmd#sec-repetition){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read [Reproduction, robustness and replication](../../background.qmd#sec-repetition) on the background page. Then read [the tasks](exercise.qmd#the-tasks) on the exercise page of the route.

## 4. The glossary

[Open the glossary](../../resources.qmd#glossary){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the glossary, which defines reproducibility, robustness and replicability side by side. Then write a paragraph in your own words that tells reproduction, robustness and replication apart and says what each of them found on the case study.

## 5. Your IDE

[Open the module on the IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read [What an IDE does](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html#sec-what) in the module on the AR4DS site, and the sections on the IDE that you chose, sections 2 to 8 for Positron and [section 10](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html#sec-other) for RStudio and VS Code. Then work through [the six steps](../../companion/ide.qmd#sec-try) of this case study, in the workspace that you have just installed.

## 6. R from the beginning

[Open Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-what){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work through the first five sections of the module on the AR4DS site, from [R and the IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-what) to [Packages](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-packages), whose blocks run in your browser.

**Shortcuts.** If R, Quarto and an IDE are already on your machine, download the workspace, run the check and install what it reports as missing, which takes about a quarter of an hour. If you already work in one of the three IDEs, take only the six steps of the IDE module. If you write R, leave the R modules until stage 2, which says what to read in them.
